request.style: English, children's song, cheerful male lead vocal with kids choir answering, acoustic guitar, piano, glockenspiel, hand claps, stomps, upbeat action song, 120 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
Zacchaeus was a little man
A rich man, short and small
He could not see when Jesus came
The crowd was much too tall
So he ran ahead, he ran ahead
And climbed up in a tree
Up in the leaves of the sycamore
Now Jesus I can see

[Chorus]
Zacchaeus, hurry down
For today I must stay at your house
Zacchaeus, hurry down
He came to seek and to save what was lost

[Verse]
He hurried down with a happy face
He welcomed him with joy
The people grumbled, grumble, grumble
What a sinful man
But Jesus went in through his door
He did not stay away
He loved the man that no one loved
And came to stay that day

[Chorus]
Zacchaeus, hurry down
For today I must stay at your house
Zacchaeus, hurry down
He came to seek and to save what was lost

[Verse]
Zacchaeus stood up tall that day
Half of all I own
I give it to the poor, he said
To every hungry home
And if I cheated anyone
I pay back four times more
One, two, three, four, count it out
And open wide the door

[Bridge]
Today salvation has come to this house
Today, today, today
Today salvation has come to this house
Clap your hands and say

[Chorus]
Zacchaeus, hurry down
For today I must stay at your house
Zacchaeus, hurry down
He came to seek and to save what was lost

[Outro]
Zacchaeus, hurry down
He came to seek and to save what was lost
